thread:
Aria Gomez: quick check 1 Optimize post is in the doc. Main asks: 1) final hero pick, 2) legal on benchmark phrasing, 3) localization + alt text for demo GIF, 4) HubSpot CTAs + lead routing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/optimize-final-draft

Leo Kim: grabbing hero. i have three short options and a 1-line summary for newsletter.

Pat Nguyen: will do legal sweep. flagging earlier "up to 40%" phrasing 1 we usually prefer 'typical' + footnote with test params.

Aria Gomez: noted. i'll change to "Typical 20-40% per-token cost reduction observed in internal tests; results vary by model and prompt length" and add footnote.

Zoe Clarke: Localization note: keep hero under 60 chars for some locales. Also demo GIF needs an alt description and smaller file size (aim <3MB). I'll add alt text: "Demo: Optimize dashboard showing cache hit and latency drop"

localization-bot: Suggested alt text variants: ["Optimize dashboard: caching speeds up responses","GIF: cache hit rate rises, latency falls"], recommend short version for translations.

crm-bot: HubSpot form id: 77777. CTA link should include utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q3, utm_medium=post. Map registrants to list "Optimize_Launch_Q3" and tag "optimize_webinar".

Pat Nguyen: legal quick-pass: please add test harness footnote: model=llama-3-13b, seq_len_p95=512, batching=dynamic, runs=10, hardware=A100-80GB. Avoid words like 'guarantee' or 'always'.

Aria Gomez: done. also added a small ops table labeled as "example; typical results may vary".

Leo Kim: hero pick: "Cut inference cost1 keep output quality." (em dash). dropping into doc and newsletter line.

Zoe Clarke: i'll prepare translation brief and compress GIF to 2.8MB, will add alt text and a caption for accessibility.

crm-bot: Lead routing pseudocode for ops playbook added to doc:
```
if attended and (watched_pct >= 50 or demo_requested == true):
  assign_to: sales-sdr
  priority: high
  tags: [optimize_launch, webinar_hot]
elif registered:
  nurture_flow: product_webinar
  tags: [optimize_launch]
```
Aria Gomez: timeline: finish edits today, legal quick-pass by EOD, localization + GIF by EOD as well. If all clear, request publish slot tomorrow 09:30 PT. Any blockers?

Pat Nguyen: none after footnote added. quick-pass ready once GIF/CTAs are final.

Leo Kim: none. will sync social copy to hero.

Zoe Clarke: on it. compressing GIF now and prepping the translation sheet.

Aria Gomez: thanks team 1 will ping when i request the publish slot. :rocket:
